llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文专注于生物墨水的材料配方，未涉及任何人工智能技术。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses solely on bioink material formulation and biological characterization, with no integration of AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发一种一体化的生物墨水用于胰岛类器官，以促进血管生成和免疫调节。
summary_zh.method: 将明胶甲基丙烯酰、细胞外基质和富血小板血浆复合制备定制化生物墨水。
summary_zh.result: 该生物墨水支持胰岛类器官的生长并具有促血管生成和免疫调节功能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外细胞实验验证生物墨水功能。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a customized bioink that integrates multiple functionalities for islet organoid culture, aiming to promote angiogenesis and immune regulation.
summary_en.method: Composite bioink was fabricated by combining GelMA, extracellular matrix, and platelet-rich plasma.
summary_en.result: The three-in-one bioink supported islet organoid formation and demonstrated pro-angiogenic and immunoregulatory properties.
summary_en.validation: Functional validation was performed through in vitro cell culture assays.
